macros.name: DTLdisplayinnerlabel
macros.doc: This is used to format the inner label.

macros.name: DTLdisplayouterlabel
macros.doc: This is used to format the outer label.

macros.name: DTLdocurrentpiesegmentcolor
macros.doc: This command is intended for use within \DTLpiechart as a shortcut that will set the current text colour to that of the current segment.

macros.name: DTLdopiesegmentcolor
macros.doc: Locally sets the current colour (with \color) to that associated with the ⟨n⟩th segment.

macros.name: DTLpieatbegintikz
macros.doc: This hook is used at the start of the tikzpicture environment, allowing you to change the tikzpicture settings.

macros.name: DTLpieatendtikz
macros.doc: This hook is used at the end of the tikzpicture environment, allowing you to add additional content, which may overlap the chart.

macros.name: DTLpiechart
macros.doc: This draws a pie chart using data provided in the database identified by ⟨db-name⟩.

macros.name: DTLpieoutlinewidth
macros.doc: Length register that stores the width of the segment outline.

macros.name: DTLpiepercent
macros.doc: \DTLpiepercent returns the percentage value of the current segment.

macros.name: DTLpievariable
macros.doc: The expansion text of this command should be the control sequence used to identify the column of data used to compute the size of each segment.

macros.name: DTLsetpiesegmentcolor
macros.doc: Assign colour name ⟨color⟩ to the ⟨n⟩th segment.
